name: Kanban Board with Click-to-Move
summary: Interactive kanban board with 4 columns (To Do, In Progress, Review, Done) featuring click-to-move task management. Each column renders as a Card with ScrollArea for overflow handling. Task cards display title, description, priority Badge (Low/Medium/High/Urgent), and assignee Avatar. Clicking a task opens a Dialog with full details and a Select to move between columns. Each column has an Add Task button that opens a Dialog with Input, Textarea, and Select for priority. Uses useArrayState for each column's task array (4 separate arrays), React.useMemo for live task counts per column, setState for moveTask/addTask operations, and Motion animation on card entrance. Includes toast notifications on add, move, and delete operations. Ships with 12 demo tasks distributed across all columns.
shortSummary: Kanban board with 4 columns, click-to-move tasks, add/delete dialogs, priority badges, and animated cards
